tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen. Same navy as the pitch deck background.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and cards that sit on surface-ground, always framed with line-hairline. Added for the app: the deck draws panels as outlines only.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: 1px frames around panels, dividers and table rules (35% of accent). Decorative only: about 2.2:1 on surface-ground, so never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The deck's soft blue. Key figures, links, focus rings, selected items and control borders. 10.8:1 on surface-ground, 9.6:1 on surface-panel.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Frame of the active or focused panel, input and button borders, selected rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the large dB figure on surface-ground and surface-panel. 19.6:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and units. 9.1:1 on surface-ground, 8.1:1 on surface-panel.

tokens.name: signal-alert
tokens.usage: Anomaly detected and the recommendation. The only warm color: use it only when the mix has drifted. Added for the app (not in the deck). 11:1 on surface-ground.

tokens.name: signal-ok
tokens.usage: Recovered, baseline accepted, check passed. Added for the app (not in the deck). 11.5:1 on surface-ground.

styles.name: figure-hero
styles.usage: The single big readout on the Live screen. Use once per screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: The recommendation line and primary explanations.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units, confidence, timestamps. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase field and column labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between related items; button padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and screen margins.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels and frames: square corners, as in the deck.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small tags such as the confidence chip.

tokens.name: glow-edge
tokens.usage: Soft blue glow around the active panel, echoing the glowing slide edges of the deck. Use on one panel at a time.
